plan.title: DESeq2 LRT for treatment x time interaction
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a 2-condition x 4-timepoint (t0-t3) bulk RNA-seq time course with 3 replicates per cell (25 columns total = 24 samples + gene symbol column, matching the 24x4 metadata), raw salmon-derived integer counts across 12000 genes. The research question — genes with a treatment-specific change over time beyond the shared time trend — is a classic condition x time interaction question, best answered with DESeq2's likelihood ratio test (LRT): fit a full model ~condition + time + condition:time and a reduced model ~condition + time, so the LRT isolates genes whose time trajectory differs by condition (interaction) after already accounting for the additive condition and time main effects (the 'shared time trend'). Given only 3 replicates per condition:time cell, time is treated as a categorical factor (4 levels) rather than a continuous spline, which is appropriate for a well-powered but small n and avoids assuming a specific functional shape. Because package availability is unknown, the plan requires the executing agent to probe for DESeq2 first; if genuinely absent, it must fall back to a limma-voom equivalent (same full/reduced design compared via moderated F-test) rather than fail outright. Steps: (1) QC/normalization and design matrix construction, (2) DESeq2 LRT for the interaction term producing a ranked gene list with FDR, (3) clustering of significant interaction genes into trajectory patterns (e.g., diverging early vs late) for interpretability, (4) enrichment analysis of the interaction-significant gene set against pathway gene sets, contingent on reference availability. No reference store is currently provisioned; the enrichment step is written to degrade to a reported gap (not a failure) if no gene-set reference materializes at run time.
